product_metadata.title: AIYAKA 3 Tier Stackable Can Rack Organizer,for food storage,kitchen cabinets or countertops,Storage for 36 cans,2-piece,Bronze
features: ✅【STACKABLE DESIGN】This Can Rack Can Hold Up to 36 Cans, You Can Stack All the Cans On The Shelf to Save Family Space
✅【LARGE CAPACITY】The Can Rack can store up 36 all kinds of cans, jars, drinks, food and so on.It is very suitable for kitchens, cabinets, living rooms, balconies, bathrooms, and rooms.
✅【ADJUSTABLE DIVIDING LINE】with the help of 6 adjustable dividing lines, you can reasonably plan the shelf space, make it neat and easy to store
✅【TILT DESIGN】The Can Rack is designed to tilt 30 degrees. When you remove the front cans, the back cans will roll to the front for easy removal and putting down
✅【STABLE STRUCTURE】Can Rack is made of metal materials and has a stable structure. Easy to install without too many tools
